description: Polished card summaries for wiki-import moments (event_id keys).

summaries.none-solo-and-iwatch-mei-2013present-a-d: A diss track titled "I Wash Cars" leaked online, targeting Sumerian Records, founder Ash Avildsen, Lorenzo "The Main Event" Antonucci, and I See Stars. Avildsen and Antonucci replied with "When Ronnie Met Sally." The feud was later resolved and Radke said the two sides were on good terms again.
summaries.2013-solo-and-iwatch-mei-2013present-on-: On May 31, 2013, Radke launched his YouTube channel and released the solo song "Fair-Weather Fans," described as a message to people who did not believe in him. He followed with "What Up Earth?" the next day.
summaries.2013-solo-and-iwatch-mei-2013present-in-: In an Alternative Press interview, Radke said he was working on a free rap mixtape produced by Charles Massabo (Kallaghan Records), planned for December 2013, with guest features from established rap artists.
summaries.2021-solo-and-iwatch-mei-2013present-in-: Radke told Loudwire he was still developing a rap mixtape, continuing the solo era plans he had discussed in earlier interviews.
summaries.2022-solo-and-iwatch-mei-2013present-in-: Radke drew press coverage—including from Loudwire—after public back-and-forth with Papa Roach frontman Jacoby Shaddix.
summaries.2013-personal-life-radke-has-one-daughte: Radke has a daughter from his relationship with model Crissy Henderson. He was engaged to Henderson at one point; the couple later separated.
summaries.2013-personal-life-radkes-older-brother-: Radke's older brother Anthony died in a traffic collision in 2013.
summaries.2022-personal-life-in-december-2022-radk: In December 2022, Radke published the memoir I Can Explain with journalist Ryan J. Downey.
summaries.2024-personal-life-in-december-2024-radk: In December 2024, Radke was denied entry to the United Kingdom because of his prior prison sentence, which affected Falling in Reverse tour plans.
summaries.2014-falling-in-reverse-2008present-thum: Falling in Reverse performed at Rock im Park 2014; Radke appeared with the band during that festival cycle.
summaries.2020-falling-in-reverse-2008present-fall: Falling in Reverse's first two albums reached the U.S. top 20, and all four studio albums through that point had charted in the top 40.
summaries.1983-early-life-ronald-joseph-radke-was-: Ronald Joseph Aaron Radke was born in Las Vegas. Wikipedia's early-life section also discusses his family background and later comments about fatherhood shaping his outlook.
summaries.2004-career-in-high-school-radke-and-max: In Las Vegas, Radke and Max Green linked up with Bryan Money and Robert Ortiz; Omar Espinosa and Carson Allen joined, forming Escape the Fate and recording their early demo.
summaries.2004-escape-the-fate-20042008-in-high-sc: Escape the Fate came together in Las Vegas after auditions organized by Bryan Money, with Radke on vocals and Max Green among the founding members.
summaries.2006-escape-the-fate-20042008-in-may-200: In May 2006 the band began recording the EP There's No Sympathy for the Dead and material for debut album Dying Is Your Latest Fashion with producer Elvis Baskette.
summaries.2008-escape-the-fate-20042008-radke-was-: Radke was removed from Escape the Fate in 2008 after a probation violation led to a prison sentence; Craig Mabbitt became the new vocalist.
summaries.2009-escape-the-fate-20042008-during-rad: While Radke was in prison, tension with Mabbitt escalated through live shows and social media, including a notorious Warped Tour heckle exchange.
summaries.2009-career-during-radkes-incarceration: During Radke's incarceration, the feud with Craig Mabbitt played out publicly between Escape the Fate and Radke's online posts.
summaries.2010-falling-in-reverse-2008present-whil: Radke wrote early Falling in Reverse material in prison; the band later issued "Raised by Wolves" and the album The Drug in Me Is You after his release.
summaries.2010-career-while-serving-his-sentence-a: While incarcerated, Radke began shaping Falling in Reverse, setting up the comeback that continued after his 2010 release.
summaries.2013-escape-the-fate-20042008-by-october: By late 2013 Radke and Mabbitt had reconciled; Escape the Fate and Falling in Reverse co-headlined the Bury the Hatchet tour in 2014.
